    48→            {

    55→                            "value" to value,

    70→    override fun search(
    71→        type: Type,
    72→        size: Int,
    73→        searchColumn: SearchColumn,
    74→        value: String?,
    75→        isMatch: Boolean,
    76→        searchAfter: List<String>?,
    77→        sortType: SortType,
    78→    ): SearchAfterResult<Dictionary> {
    79→        val sortQuery =
    80→            when (sortType) {
    81→                SortType.UPDATED -> searchAfterSortQuery()
    82→                SortType.KEYWORD -> keywordSearchAfterSortQuery(type)
    83→            }
    84→
    85→        val response =
    86→            esClient.search(
    87→                { s ->
    88→                    s
    89→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
    90→                        .trackTotalHits { it.enabled(true) }
    91→                        .query { q ->
    92→                            q.bool { b ->
    93→                                // type 필터 (항상 적용)
    94→                                b.filter { f ->
    95→                                    f.term { t ->
    96→                                        t
    97→                                            .field("type")
    98→                                            .value { v -> v.stringValue(type.toString()) }
    99→                                    }
   100→                                }
   101→                                // 검색어가 있을 때만 검색 쿼리 추가
   102→                                if (value != null) {
   103→                                    addSearchQuery(b, searchColumn, value, isMatch)
   104→                                }
   105→                                b
   106→                            }
   107→                        }.size(size)
   108→                        .sort(sortQuery)
   109→                        .apply {
   110→                            searchAfter?.let { sa ->
   111→                                searchAfter(sa.map { FieldValue.of(it) })
   112→                            }
   113→                        }
   114→                },
   115→                Dictionary::class.java,
   116→            )
   117→
   118→        val hits = response.hits().hits()
   119→        val items =
   120→            hits.mapNotNull { hit ->
   121→                hit.id()?.let { id ->
   122→                    hit.source()?.let { Dictionary(id, it.keyword, it.type, it.value, it.createdTime, it.updatedTime) }
   123→                }
   124→            }
   125→        val total = response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0L
   126→        val nextSearchAfter =
   127→            hits.lastOrNull()?.sort()?.map { fieldValue ->
   128→                fieldValue._get().toString()

   135→    /**

   138→    private fun addSearchQuery(
   139→        boolQuery: BoolQuery.Builder,
   140→        searchColumn: SearchColumn,
   141→        value: String,
   142→        isMatch: Boolean,
   143→    ) {
   144→        val fields =
   145→            when (searchColumn) {
   146→                SearchColumn.ALL -> listOf("keyword", "value")
   147→                SearchColumn.KEYWORD -> listOf("keyword")
   148→                SearchColumn.VALUE -> listOf("value")
   149→            }
   150→
   151→        val shouldQueries =
   152→            fields.map { field ->
   153→                if (isMatch) {
   154→                    Query.of { q ->
   155→                        q.match { m ->
   156→                            m.field(field)
   157→                            m.query { qv -> qv.stringValue(value) }
   158→                        }
   159→                    }
   160→                } else {
   161→                    Query.of { q ->
   162→                        q.wildcard { w ->
   163→                            w.field(field)
   164→                            w.value("*$value*")
   165→                        }
   166→                    }
   167→                }
   168→            }
   169→
   170→        boolQuery.should(shouldQueries)
   171→        boolQuery.minimumShouldMatch("1")
   172→    }

   174→    override fun findAllByType(type: Type): List<Dictionary> {
   175→        val allResults = mutableListOf<Dictionary>()
   176→        var searchAfter: List<FieldValue>? = null
   177→        val batchSize = 10000
   178→
   179→        do {
   180→            val response =
   181→                esClient.search(
   182→                    { s ->
   183→                        s
   184→                            .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   185→                            .query { q ->
   186→                                q.term { t ->
   187→                                    t
   188→                                        .field("type")
   189→                                        .value { v -> v.stringValue(type.toString()) }
   190→                                }
   191→                            }.size(batchSize)
   192→                            .sort { so ->
   193→                                so.field { f ->
   194→                                    f.field("createdTime").order(SortOrder.Asc)
   195→                                }
   196→                            }.apply {
   197→                                searchAfter?.let { sa -> searchAfter(sa) }
   198→                            }
   199→                    },
   200→                    Dictionary::class.java,
   201→                )
   202→
   203→            val hits = response.hits().hits()
   204→            hits.mapNotNull { it.source() }.let { allResults.addAll(it) }
   205→
   206→            searchAfter = hits.lastOrNull()?.sort()
   207→        } while (searchAfter != null && response.hits().hits().size == batchSize)
   208→
   209→        return allResults
   210→    }

   212→    override fun findLastModifiedByType(type: Type): Pair<Instant?, Long> {
   213→        val response =
   214→            esClient.search(
   215→                { s ->
   216→                    s
   217→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   218→                        .size(0) // We only need aggregation results, not documents
   219→                        .query { q ->
   220→                            q.term { t ->
   221→                                t.field("type").value(type.name)
   222→                            }
   223→                        }.aggregations("max_updated_time") { agg ->
   224→                            agg.max { m -> m.field("updatedTime") }
   225→                        }
   226→                },
   227→                Dictionary::class.java,
   228→            )
   229→
   230→        val total = response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0L
   231→        val maxAgg = response.aggregations()["max_updated_time"]?.max()
   232→        // ES returns NaN for empty aggregation results
   233→        val lastModified =
   234→            maxAgg?.value()?.takeIf { !it.isNaN() }?.let {
   235→                Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.toLong())
   236→            }
   237→
   238→        return Pair(lastModified, total)
   239→    }

   241→    override fun findLastModifiedForAllTypes(): Map<Type, Pair<Instant?, Long>> {
   242→        val response =
   243→            esClient.search(
   244→                { s ->
   245→                    s
   246→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   247→                        .size(0) // We only need aggregation results
   248→                        .aggregations("by_type") { agg ->
   249→                            agg
   250→                                .terms { t ->
   251→                                    t.field("type").size(Type.entries.size)
   252→                                }.aggregations("max_updated_time") { subAgg ->
   253→                                    subAgg.max { m -> m.field("updatedTime") }
   254→                                }
   255→                        }
   256→                },
   257→                Dictionary::class.java,
   258→            )
   259→
   260→        val byTypeAgg = response.aggregations()["by_type"]?.sterms()
   261→        val resultMap = mutableMapOf<Type, Pair<Instant?, Long>>()
   262→
   263→        // Initialize all types with null/0
   264→        Type.entries.forEach { type ->
   265→            resultMap[type] = Pair(null, 0L)
   266→        }
   267→
   268→        // Update with actual values from aggregation
   269→        byTypeAgg?.buckets()?.array()?.forEach { bucket ->
   270→            val typeName = bucket.key().stringValue()
   271→            val type = Type.entries.find { it.name == typeName }
   272→            if (type != null) {
   273→                val count = bucket.docCount()
   274→                val maxAgg = bucket.aggregations()["max_updated_time"]?.max()
   275→                val lastModified =
   276→                    maxAgg?.value()?.takeIf { !it.isNaN() }?.let {
   277→                        Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.toLong())
   278→                    }
   279→                resultMap[type] = Pair(lastModified, count)
   280→            }
   281→        }
   282→
   283→        return resultMap
   284→    }

   309→                        }

   315→        val resultMap = mutableMapOf<Type, Long>()
   316→
   317→        // Initialize all types with 0
   318→        Type.entries.forEach { type ->
   319→            resultMap[type] = 0L
   320→        }
   321→
   322→        // Update with actual values from aggregation
   323→        byTypeAgg?.buckets()?.array()?.forEach { bucket ->
   324→            val typeName = bucket.key().stringValue()

   334→    private fun baseSortQuery() =
   335→        SortOptions.of {
   336→            it.field { f ->
   337→                f.field("updatedTime")
   338→                f.order(SortOrder.Desc)
   339→            }

   346→    private fun searchAfterSortQuery(): List<SortOptions> =
   347→        listOf(
   348→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field("updatedTime").order(SortOrder.Desc) } },
   349→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field("createdTime").order(SortOrder.Desc) } },
   350→            // Use _shard_doc instead of _id (ES 8.x disallows _id fielddata by default)
   351→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field("_shard_doc").order(SortOrder.Asc) } },

   354→    private fun keywordSortQuery(type: Type) =
   355→        SortOptions.of {
   356→            it.field { f ->
   357→                f.field(getSortFieldForType(type))
   358→                f.order(SortOrder.Asc)

   360→        }

   362→    private fun keywordSearchAfterSortQuery(type: Type): List<SortOptions> =
   363→        listOf(
   364→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field(getSortFieldForType(type)).order(SortOrder.Asc) } },

    11→/**
    12→ * 바이너리 데이터 출력 클래스
    13→ * Lucene 스타일의 가변길이 인코딩 지원
    14→ * 기존 Java analysis-product의 DataOutput과 100% 호환
    15→ */
    16→class BinaryDataOutput(
    17→    private val out: OutputStream,
    18→) : Closeable {
    19→    private val buffered: BufferedOutputStream =
    20→        out as? BufferedOutputStream ?: BufferedOutputStream(out)
    21→
    22→    fun writeByte(b: Int) {
    23→        buffered.write(b)
    24→    }
    25→
    26→    fun writeBytes(
    27→        b: ByteArray,
    28→        offset: Int = 0,
    29→        length: Int = b.size,
    30→    ) {
    31→        buffered.write(b, offset, length)
    32→    }
    33→
    34→    /**
    35→     * 4바이트 정수 (Big-Endian)
    36→     */
    37→    fun writeInt(i: Int) {
    38→        writeByte((i shr 24) and 0xFF)
    39→        writeByte((i shr 16) and 0xFF)
    40→        writeByte((i shr 8) and 0xFF)
    41→        writeByte(i and 0xFF)
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    /**
    45→     * 2바이트 정수 (Big-Endian)
    46→     */
    47→    fun writeShort(i: Int) {
    48→        writeByte((i shr 8) and 0xFF)
    49→        writeByte(i and 0xFF)
    50→    }
    51→
    52→    /**
    53→     * 가변길이 정수 (1-5 bytes)
    54→     * 작은 값은 적은 바이트 사용
    55→     */
    56→    fun writeVInt(value: Int) {
    57→        var i = value
    58→        while ((i and 0x7F.inv()) != 0) {
    59→            writeByte((i and 0x7F) or 0x80)
    60→            i = i ushr 7
    61→        }
    62→        writeByte(i)
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    /**
    66→     * 8바이트 Long
    67→     */
    68→    fun writeLong(i: Long) {
    69→        writeInt((i shr 32).toInt())
    70→        writeInt(i.toInt())
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    /**
    74→     * 가변길이 Long (1-9 bytes)
    75→     */
    76→    fun writeVLong(value: Long) {
    77→        var i = value

   152→ */
   153→class BinaryDataInput(
   154→    private val input: InputStream,
   155→) : Closeable {
   156→    private val buffered: BufferedInputStream =
   157→        input as? BufferedInputStream ?: BufferedInputStream(input)
   158→
   159→    fun readByte(): Int {
   160→        val b = buffered.read()
   161→        if (b == -1) throw EOFException("Unexpected end of stream")
   162→        return b
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    fun readBytes(
   166→        b: ByteArray,
   167→        offset: Int = 0,
   168→        len: Int = b.size,
   169→    ) {
   170→        var remaining = len
   171→        var off = offset
   172→        while (remaining > 0) {
   173→            val read = buffered.read(b, off, remaining)
   174→            if (read == -1) throw EOFException("Unexpected end of stream")
   175→            remaining -= read
   176→            off += read
   177→        }
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    fun readInt(): Int =
   181→        ((readByte() and 0xFF) shl 24) or
   182→            ((readByte() and 0xFF) shl 16) or
   183→            ((readByte() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
   184→            (readByte() and 0xFF)
   185→
   186→    fun readShort(): Int = ((readByte() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (readByte() and 0xFF)
   187→
   188→    fun readVInt(): Int {
   189→        var b = readByte()
   190→        if (b >= 0) return b
   191→
   192→        var i = b and 0x7F
   193→        b = readByte()
   194→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F) shl 7)
   195→        if (b >= 0) return i
   196→
   197→        b = readByte()
   198→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F) shl 14)
   199→        if (b >= 0) return i
   200→
   201→        b = readByte()
   202→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F) shl 21)
   203→        if (b >= 0) return i
   204→
   205→        b = readByte()
   206→        i = i or ((b and 0x0F) shl 28)
   207→        if ((b and 0xF0) == 0) return i
   208→
   209→        throw IOException("Invalid vInt detected (too many bits)")
   210→    }
   211→
   212→    fun readLong(): Long = (readInt().toLong() shl 32) or (readInt().toLong() and 0xFFFFFFFFL)
   213→
   214→    fun readVLong(): Long {
   215→        var b = readByte()
   216→        if (b >= 0) return b.toLong()
   217→
   218→        var i = (b and 0x7F).toLong()
   219→        b = readByte()
   220→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 7)
   221→        if (b >= 0) return i
   222→
   223→        b = readByte()
   224→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 14)
   225→        if (b >= 0) return i
   226→
   227→        b = readByte()
   228→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 21)
   229→        if (b >= 0) return i
   230→
   231→        b = readByte()
   232→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 28)
   233→        if (b >= 0) return i
   234→
   235→        b = readByte()
   236→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 35)
   237→        if (b >= 0) return i
   238→
   239→        b = readByte()
   240→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 42)
   241→        if (b >= 0) return i
   242→
   243→        b = readByte()
   244→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 49)
   245→        if (b >= 0) return i
   246→
   247→        b = readByte()
   248→        i = i or ((b and 0x7F).toLong() shl 56)
   249→        if (b >= 0) return i
   250→
   251→        throw IOException("Invalid vLong detected")
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    fun readFloat(): Float = java.lang.Float.intBitsToFloat(readInt())
   255→
   256→    fun readDouble(): Double = java.lang.Double.longBitsToDouble(readLong())
   257→
   258→    fun readBoolean(): Boolean = readByte() != 0
   259→
   260→    fun readUString(): CharArray {
   261→        val byteSize = readVInt()
   262→        val chars = CharArray(byteSize / 2)
   263→        for (i in chars.indices) {
   264→            chars[i] = readShort().toChar()
   265→        }
   266→        return chars
   267→    }
   268→
   269→    fun readString(): String = String(readUString())
   270→
   271→    fun readAString(): CharArray {
   272→        val len = readVInt()
   273→        val chars = CharArray(len)
   274→        for (i in 0 until len) {
   275→            chars[i] = readByte().toChar()
   276→        }
   277→        return chars
   278→    }

   281→        buffered.close()
   282→    }

   181→                for (word in synonyms) {

   183→                    synonymMap.getOrPut(word) { mutableListOf() }.addAll(others)

#### **SET Types** (Simple Word Sets)
1. **STOP** - Stop words → `stop.dict`
2. **USER** - User-defined words → `user.dict`
3. **ENGLISH** - English words → `english.dict`
4. **UNIT** - Unit words → `unit.dict`

**Binary Format:** `Int(size) + String[]`

#### **MAP Types** (Key-Value Mappings)
5. **SYNONYM** - Synonym mappings → `synonym.dict`
   - Format: Map + WordSet
6. **UNIT_SYNONYM** - Unit synonym mappings → `unit_synonym.dict`
   - Format: Map + WordSet
7. **SPACE** - Space separation rules → `space.dict`
   - Format: Map + WordSet
   - **Critical:** Preserves empty strings from split for RuleOne.java compatibility

**Binary Format:** `VInt(mapSize) + entries[key, values[]] + VInt(wordSetSize) + words[]`

#### **COMPOUND Type** (Complex Mapping)
8. **COMPOUND** - Compound word decomposition → `compound.dict`
   - Format: Map + MainWordSet + WordSet
   - Extracts main keywords from compound words

**Binary Format:** `VInt(mapSize) + entries[] + VInt(mainSetSize) + mainWords[] + VInt(wordSetSize) + words[]`

### **Binary Compilation Pipeline**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. Elasticsearch Data Retrieval                                 │
│    DictionaryService.compile(type)                              │
│    → DictionaryRepository.findAllByType(type)                   │
│    → Search After pagination (batch: 10,000)                    │
│    → Returns List<Dictionary>                                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                            ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 2. Data Structure Creation                                      │
│    DictionaryBinaryCompile.compileFromDictionaries()            │
│    → Extract (keyword, value) pairs                             │
│    → Convert to typed data structure:                           │
│      • SET types: SetDictionaryData(words)                      │
│      • SYNONYM types: SynonymDictionaryData(map, wordSet)       │
│      • SPACE: SpaceDictionaryData(map, wordSet)                 │
│      • COMPOUND: CompoundDictionaryData(map, main, wordSet)     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                            ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 3. Binary Serialization                                         │
│    DictionarySerializer.writeTo(data, file)                     │
│    → Type-specific serializer (e.g., SynonymDictionarySerializer)│
│    → BinaryDataOutput encodes:                                  │
│      • VInt for variable-length integers (1-5 bytes)            │
│      • UString for Unicode text (2 bytes/char)                  │
│      • Maps, Sets, Arrays per format spec                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                            ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 4. File Output                                                  │
│    Path: {dictionary.output-path}/{type}.dict                   │
│    Example: ./data/dictionary/synonym.dict                      │
│    Format: 100% compatible with Java analysis-product           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                            ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 5. Elasticsearch Dictionary Reload                              │
│    DictionaryService.reloadDictionary()                         │
│    → POST /_analysis-product-name/reload-dict                   │
│    → Analysis engine reloads binary files                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Critical Details:**
- **VInt Encoding:** 1-5 bytes per integer, smaller values use fewer bytes
- **UString Encoding:** 2 bytes per character (UTF-16), length prefix with VInt
- **Binary Compatibility:** Must match Java `analysis-product` exactly
- **SPACE Type:** Preserves empty strings from `split("\\s")` for RuleOne.java
- **Reload Once:** `compileAll()` compiles all types then reloads once (efficient)
